hero: A lone operative in a white winter camouflage jacket with a hood, black balaclava covering the face, tactical chest rig with pouches and a small amber indicator light, snow dusting the shoulders.

items.prompt: A lone operative in a white winter camouflage jacket with a hood, black balaclava, tactical chest rig, kneeling in deep snow beside railway tracks at night, looking toward concrete bunkers and a radio tower with a red beacon in the distance, boot tracks behind him.

Low angle from the snow: a rusty freight train with steel boxcars rolls past at night toward a snowbound military base, wheels throwing snow spray, the operative in white winter camouflage and black balaclava clinging to the ladder of the last wagon, red tower beacon far ahead.

Perimeter of a snowbound military base at night: a tall searchlight tower sweeps a hard white beam across chain-link fence and drifts of snow, the operative in white winter camouflage pressed flat against a frost-covered concrete wall in the shadow just outside the beam, a guard silhouette with a rifle on the walkway above.

Looking up from the base of a tall steel lattice radio tower at night, red beacon glowing through blowing snow at the top, the operative in white winter camouflage climbing the icy ladder halfway up, wind-driven snow streaking across the frame, mountains and aurora faintly behind.

Interior of a dim concrete vehicle garage at a snowbound military base, a military 6x6 truck with headlights on and exhaust steaming, the wide steel garage door half open onto a blizzard, the operative in white winter camouflage crouched behind stacked crates in the foreground, a single hanging work lamp.
